name: team-vr
title: Team VR Section
description: A tall dark team section ending in a magenta and orange glow. Three square portraits sit under a bold heading, and hovering one floods it with a hot gradient, a quote mark and a line of white text.
use: A startup or product team page wants portraits that flip into a short mission quote under the pointer.
avoid: Light or cool-palette brands: the pink-orange gradient and glow are fixed, and quotes need a cursor to read.
a11y: Quotes appear on mouse hover only, so keyboard users never read them; no reduced-motion handling is present. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Black background with a faint square grid and a strong magenta-to-orange wash along the bottom. A tiny uppercase label and a large white heading sit above three rounded square portraits shown in greyscale, each followed by a white name and a small grey role.
behaves: Cards fade up one at a time when the section scrolls into view. Hovering a portrait pushes a pink-to-orange gradient panel over it with a large quote mark, zooms and colours the photo beneath, and turns the name into a gradient; leaving reverses it.
customise: The three people, photos, roles and shared quote are a hardcoded array in the file; the pink-orange palette and glow also need source edits.
weight: light: Three photos and hover CSS; the only running animation is a one-time entrance stagger.
